title: 18 AL/BC patterns: style, data-modeling, web-services, appsource, breaking-changes, performance, testing
summary: Adds 17 AL/BC knowledge articles with good and bad samples across style, data modeling, web services, AppSource, breaking changes, performance and testing, and updates the matching review skills. The description lists a FlowFields web-services article that is not among the changed files.
key_points: 7 style articles: Boolean for binary choices, Enum over Integer, modern casing, addressable var parameters, namespace verification, English identifiers, build output location
4 data modeling articles: DimensionManagement wiring, Check/Post Line/Post Batch split, primary key immutability, TestField on required setup fields
2 web-services articles: keep consumer-provided key fields editable on insert, recalculate stored derived fields before exposing them via API
Single articles for AppSource (File data type is OnPrem-only), breaking changes (prefer the Email module), performance (Word layout) and testing (randomized complete data)
Review skills for each domain are updated to route to the new articles
quote: 18 knowledge articles generalized from patterns observed across real AppSource/PTE Business Central development
